steps.content: In the heart of winter, marking the end of an old year and the beginning of a new one.

The Bureau spruced up the rest zones with quaint decorations, and carefully designated a few safe spots for cozy campfires. Right beside these, they set up stands offering marshmallows and roasted chestnuts.
You can't help but look forward to it—the fireworks DisCity will launch for the festival.
Seriously? We can go out and play?
Well, I heard it from Wynn, and Wynn said that she heard it from Adjutant Nightingale, so I guess it's true.
It must be true then!
You just happened to plan on roasting a few chestnuts for dessert, and what do you know? You're greeted with this exhilarating news right off the bat.
Next to the crackling hearth, Luvia Ray and Ignis are busy roasting marshmallows on skewers, their soft popping sounds filling the air.
As the marshmallows turn a golden caramel color, a deliciously sweet scent wafts around, and the flickering flames paint the girls' faces in warm, blushing tones.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Why am I the last to hear about this?

steps.content: You put on a mock-serious face, clutching two chestnuts and taking a seat next to the stove, eager to join in.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Come on Chief, at least you know about it now~

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Well, don't you want to join in on the fun with the rest of us, Chief?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Then, then let's think about where to go! We need to find a place big enough for all of us!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: There are so many of us, we could even shoot a movie...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Shooting a movie? I've dabbled in that.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: But it's our valuable vacation time—we shouldn't be working through it...
You three, heads cocked to the side, are simultaneously popping marshmallows and chestnuts into your mouths.
Luvia Ray suddenly claps her hands, lighting up with a great idea.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Oh! I remember hearing about a mythical theater in Eastside when I auditioned. It's opening soon!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Theater? Those old-school, baffling shows aren't really my thing...

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Hey, it's not just any theater. It opens only during this mystical hour! Also...
Luvia Ray, with a secretive glint in her eye, inches closer to you and Ignis, her finger raised as if to reveal a secret.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Also...?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I've heard the theater's owner is quite a legend herself!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: She's the genius operating this mysterious and glamorous venue, turning numerous actors into household names. She has a talent for enabling these stars to shine and express their true selves on stage.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: She's like the entertainment industry's top talent finder! Hence her casual approach, opening the doors only once annually!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You know, this format kind of rings a bell...

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I've heard that in this theater, every nook is part of the show! Imagine, you could be walking and suddenly find yourself in the middle of a scene!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Hmm, that's unexpectedly interesting...
Looks like Ignis's getting a bit hooked by what Luvia's saying.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Right~?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Imagine if I could get some advice from this star-maker—maybe my skills would skyrocket! Then I'd make sure Chief gets to see my first show!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Hey, don't forget about me!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Hehe, of course, I'll include you too~!
Luvia Ray gets up, slides over to your other side, and together with Ignis, they playfully trap you in the middle.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Come on, Chief! Let's make this our destination! Just think, I might turn into the cutest little girl if I get to visit this theater!!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Chief, Luvia's really keen on it. Let's just check it out.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm curious... what kind of musical could they be staging?
Bathed in neon lights, the quaint three-story building echoes with strains of graceful music from behind its partially open doors.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So, this is it... the fabled Fortuna?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let's head in and find out what sets it apart.
